about_the_game:
Command the destiny of a world torn between science and sorcery in this strategic battle for the future of civilisation.

For centuries, the crimson banners of the Ironclad Pack and the azure standards of the Arcane Talon have flown over battlefields across multiple mystical realms. One embraces the precision of technology; the other channels the raw power of magic. Both seek dominance over a world that can no longer sustain their endless war.

Lead your faction’s elite forces in tactical combat across diverse realms and game modes. Whether you’re diving straight into battle, honing strategies in skirmishes, or waging prolonged wars of conquest, every decision shapes the fate of the realms. Each territory offers unique strategic advantages and challenges, from the open Plains of Sun to future biomes with their own distinct environments.

But beware—you are not alone in these contested lands. Ancient guardians such as Rezna the Dragon and the Primal Beasts defend their domains with terrible power, caring nothing for your faction’s grand ideologies.

Beyond traditional conquest, Ascending Realms offers experimental and replayable modes. Test your strategies in Instant Action, face off in Skirmish battles, or engage in Ascension Conquest, a rogue-like hero wave survival mode featuring meta-progression across runs. Experiment freely in Sandbox Mode, design your own battlegrounds with the Realm Builder, and personalise your kingdom with custom War Banners.

Victory is not forged by brute force alone—it is earned through adaptation, experimentation, and mastery.

Key Features

  • Gameplay inspired by Sensible Software’s 1991 classic Mega-Lo-Mania

  • Multiple game modes including Instant Action, Skirmish, Ascension Conquest, and Sandbox

  • Command two distinct factions with unique units, abilities, and playstyles

  • Control powerful Hero units with diverse abilities and discover loot across battles

  • Rogue-like hero survival gameplay with meta-progression in Ascension Conquest

  • Battle across multiple realms, each with unique strategic considerations and environments

  • Contend with neutral creatures that can aid your faction—or plunge the battlefield into chaos

  • Upgrade units and buildings through a Technology Tree

  • Choose when to attack—day or night—and weigh the tactical consequences

  • Create custom maps using the Realm Builder

  • Design and display your own War Banner to represent your kingdom

  • An original soundtrack inspired by the greatest RTS games of all time

  • Support for over 30 languages

In Ascending Realms, victory is not measured in a single battle but in a war of ideologies that has spanned generations.

Will you bring glory to the wolf or the eagle?
Will you forge the future with steel—or bend reality with spells?

The realms await your command.

name: Ascending Realms

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo / AMD Athlon 64 X2
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 3000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any dedicated GPU (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660, AMD Radeon HD 7850, or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or better

short_description: A medieval fantasy real-time strategy game with fast-paced autobattler combat where you command forces across contested realms in the war between the technological Ironclad Pack and magical Arcane Talon. Choose your faction or hero and advance your ideology in the war-torn world of Reznara.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Catalan, Croatian, Estonian, Filipino, Icelandic, Serbian, Slovak, Slovenian
